name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on a new EU-wide online portal for companies that send workers temporarily to another EU country. Today each country has its own declaration system, which is a paperwork burden. The portal would use one standard form in all EU languages. Countries could choose to join. Parliament wants the form fixed in the law itself, more data kept, and stronger checks against abuse, while keeping protection for posted workers.

- One free multilingual portal and standard form replace separate national declaration systems for countries that join.
- Companies posting workers gain; national inspectors, social partners and the EU Labour Authority get more data.
- Parliament's position now goes to EU governments for negotiation; the law is not final yet.
